PluginData.Author: ColbyJack
PluginData.Tooltip: Play in a SteamVR headset with motion controls.
PluginData.Description:
Play Space Engineers in a SteamVR headset, with VTOL VR inspired interactive cockpits and in-game joysticks.
- Stereo rendering, 6DOF tracking, motion controls and roomscale - Interactive vanilla and DLC cockpits using the existing model controls - Grab and operate joysticks, steering wheels, handlebars and throttles - Tools and weapons with two-handed support - VR building with painting, symmetry, blueprints, planets and 3rd person building - 3rd person and spectator views with hand-controlled camera movement - Wrist HUD and tablet, radial menus, floating game menus and a VR keyboard - Interactive LCDs, including Arthur and TouchScreenAPI - Camera, turret and remote-grid views using picture-in-picture - Admin, spectator and all other game menus in VR - Multiplayer, with an optional flatscreen companion plugin
Start SteamVR before launching. Touch controllers are fully supported. Controls, source and issues: https://github.com/ColbyJack1134/SpaceEngineersVR
